findings.counterevidence: The module-interface resource uses the repository VERSIONINFO pattern; no executable VERSIONINFO block exists in this DEPiP resource.

findings.claim: Selector lifetime is not covered by the exit watcher.

sources.excerpt: auto selector = winrt::make<DisplaySelectorWindow>();`nwinrt::get_self<DisplaySelectorWindow>(selector)->Initialize(`n    std::move(displays),`n    [this](DisplayInfo const& source) {`n        auto mirror = winrt::make<MirrorWindow>();`n        winrt::get_self<MirrorWindow>(mirror)->Initialize(source);`n        m_window = mirror;`n        mirror.Activate();`n    });`nm_window = selector;`nselector.Activate();

findings.counterevidence: The callback starts the mirror only after selection; the selector is the active window before that point.

findings.claim: Event callback and lifecycle methods access enabled/process state without synchronization.

sources.excerpt: m_exitEvent = CreateDefaultEvent(DEPiPConstants::ExitEvent);`nm_reloadSettingsEvent = CreateDefaultEvent(DEPiPConstants::ReloadSettingsEvent);`nm_showEvent = CreateDefaultEvent(CommonSharedConstants::SHOW_DEPIP_EVENT);`nm_showEventWaiter.start(CommonSharedConstants::SHOW_DEPIP_EVENT, [this](DWORD error) {`n    if (m_enabled && error == ERROR_SUCCESS)`n    {`n        launch();`n    }`n});

findings.counterevidence: disable and destroy close events/process handles while the waiter remains registered.

sources.excerpt: private const int AllowAnyProcess = -1;`n`n[DllImport("user32.dll")]`nprivate static extern bool AllowSetForegroundWindow(int processId);`n...`ncase ModuleType.DEPiP:`n    AllowSetForegroundWindow(AllowAnyProcess);`n    using (var eventHandle = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.AutoReset, Constants.ShowDEPiPSharedEvent()))

findings.counterevidence: The code explicitly passes -1; the intended launch target is Runner, not every process.

findings.claim: Capture initialization in the selection callback is outside OnLaunched try/catch.

sources.excerpt: void App::OnLaunched(Microsoft::UI::Xaml::LaunchActivatedEventArgs const&)`n{`n    try`n    {`n        ...`n        [this](DisplayInfo const& source) {`n            auto mirror = winrt::make<MirrorWindow>();`n            winrt::get_self<MirrorWindow>(mirror)->Initialize(source);`n            m_window = mirror;`n            mirror.Activate();`n        });

findings.counterevidence: The try/catch surrounds OnLaunched synchronously; the callback executes later from the selector interaction.

findings.claim: Frame handling clamps copy dimensions but does not resize capture resources on content-size changes.

sources.excerpt: auto frame = sender.TryGetNextFrame();`n...`nauto source = GetDXGIInterface<ID3D11Texture2D>(frame.Surface());`n...`nsource->GetDesc(&sourceDescription);`ntarget->GetDesc(&targetDescription);`nD3D11_BOX sourceBox{`n  0, 0, 0,`n  std::min(sourceDescription.Width, targetDescription.Width),`n  std::min(sourceDescription.Height, targetDescription.Height),`n  1,`n};`n...`nm_swapChain->Present(1, 0);

findings.counterevidence: The implementation only computes a minimum copy rectangle; no ContentSize-triggered recreation is present.

findings.claim: ApplySettings repeatedly sets HWND_NOTOPMOST when always-on-top is false.

sources.excerpt: void MirrorWindow::ApplySettings()`n{`n    SetWindowPos(`n        m_window,`n        m_settings.alwaysOnTop ? HWND_TOPMOST : HWND_NOTOPMOST,`n        0,`n        0,`n        0,`n        0,`n        SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOACTIVATE);

findings.counterevidence: ReloadSettings calls ApplySettings directly, so the z-order operation is repeated on each settings reload.
